comment_letters.staff_ask: Staff asked why Lilly excluded upfront payments for acquired IPR&D (asset deals and licenses) from non-GAAP when they look like normal recurring cash operating expenses.
comment_letters.company_answer: Lilly argued at length the charges were unpredictable 'buy-in' investments, then after calls agreed that from Q1 2022 non-GAAP would include acquired IPR&D upfronts and development milestones, recasting prior periods.
comment_letters.next_filing_disclosure: FY2022 10-K highlights acquired IPR&D and development milestones of $908.5M (2022) and $970.1M (2021); from 2022 these are no longer adjusted out of non-GAAP EPS.
comment_letters.why_it_matters: Lilly's own letter warned it might stop giving non-GAAP guidance without the adjustment; the change lowers adjusted EPS by every BD deal and matters to any EPS-based bonus (see incentive_metrics).
comment_letters.impact_estimate: Acquired IPR&D in non-GAAP: 2018 $1.98B, 2019 $0.24B, 2020 $0.66B, 9M 2021 $0.50B (reply table); 2021 full year $970M ~ $1.07/share pre-tax at ~0.9B shares.
comment_letters.staff_quote: For each type of acquired IPR&D transaction (i.e., asset acquisitions, license agreements, etc.), explain to us why you believe it is appropriate to include non- GAAP adjustments for these upfront payments given that these expenditures appear to be normal, recurring, cash operating expenses necessary to operate your business.
comment_letters.reply_quote: In response to the Staff's comment and as discussed with the Staff, beginning with Lilly's earnings release for the quarter ended March 31, 2022, Lilly will not include adjustments for upfront charges and developmental milestones related to acquired in-process research and development projects acquired in a transaction other than a business combination in presentations of its non-GAAP measures.

comment_letters.next_filing_disclosure: No new 10-K disclosure committed beyond 'will continue to evaluate'.
comment_letters.why_it_matters: Low case value: the ESG-vs-filing gap was closed by immaterial numbers, no hidden economics.
comment_letters.impact_estimate: Immaterial per company (property insurance 0.078% / 0.077% / ~0.08% of COGS+opex 2020-2022).
comment_letters.staff_quote: We note that you provided more expansive disclosure in your 2022 ESG Report, CDP 2022 Climate response and 2022 CDP Water Security response than you provided in your SEC filings.
